read: Adoption of the fixed anchored wrong seed as decoding temperature rises: {'t0.0': 0.7417, 't0.3': 0.7167, 't0.7': 0.7528, 't1.0': 0.7139}. A roughly flat curve means the cascade is not a greedy-decoding artifact and survives sampling; a sharp drop at higher temperature would mean adoption depends on the model committing to its single most likely token. The temp>0 within-case flip fractions {'t0.3': 0.275, 't0.7': 0.275, 't1.0': 0.2667} are the run-to-run reliability envelope (#204): the share of cases whose repeated sampled draws disagree, i.e. how reproducible a single sampled adoption verdict is.
